name: Ougi Haruna
source:
An artificial human who has come to fight alongside the protagonist. Although she can be a little absent-minded, she is a loyal maid type girl who will do her best for her master, anytime, anywhere.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_kaguya/mamotte/sinsaku1.htm]Official Site[/url]]
